General information only

The site is here to introduce Sundello homes and work housing. What it says is general information, not professional advice.

Concept imagery

Renderings, floor plans and other imagery on the site are concepts. They show an idea of a home or finish and may differ from what is built.

Prices are estimates, not offers

Where the site shows a starting price, it is an estimate. It is not an offer, a quote or a commitment to sell at that price. Site work, permits, options and other costs can change what a home costs. Any price is only confirmed by Sundello in writing.

Specifications can change

Specifications, features, finishes, availability and options may change at any time without notice. Please confirm final specifications, site requirements and availability with Sundello.

Requests are not orders

Sending a quote request, using the customizer, or chatting with us does not create an order or a contract. It lets us follow up with you.

No warranty from this site

The site is provided as is. Nothing on it is a warranty or guarantee, and nothing on it should be read as promising a particular result.

Your information

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The date at the top shows when they were last changed.
